findings.evidence: The boundaryless counterparts `ae_restrict_image_chart_symm`, `ae_restrict_image_symm_of_ae` and `coord_ae_eq_of_coord_ae_eq` are at `FiniteBundleAtlas/Measure.lean:61,88,98`, outside `Sobolev/`. `halfCoord_def` is at `FiniteBundleAtlas/HalfPlane.lean:236`.
findings.fix: Move the whole `Measure` section, with the `Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.Jacobian` import, into `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/FiniteBundleAtlas/HalfPlane.lean`, which already defines `halfImage`, `halfCoord` and `mem_halfImage` and imports Lebesgue measure on ℂ. Have the Sobolev file import it from there.
findings.issue: Five lemmas are pure `FiniteBundleAtlas` facts over `ClosedUpperHalfPlane` but sit in a Sobolev change-of-atlas file, so other users of half-plane atlases would have to import Sobolev theory to get them: `coe_chart_mem_halfImage`, the private `differentiableOn_chart_chart_symm`, `ae_restrict_halfImage_chart_symm`, `ae_restrict_halfImage_symm_of_ae` and `halfCoord_ae_eq_of_halfCoord_ae_eq`. The `Measure` section uses no Sobolev material.

findings.evidence: `coord_eq_coordChangeL_coord` is at `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean:594`. The proof only rewrites `halfCoord_def` and applies that lemma.
findings.fix: Move it, with its `Linear` section, to `FiniteBundleAtlas/HalfPlane.lean` next to `halfCoord_def` and `halfCoord_eq_coordChange`.
findings.issue: `FiniteBundleAtlas.halfCoord_eq_coordChangeL_halfCoord` is an atlas lemma about how readings in two charts are related on their overlap. It is placed in a Sobolev file, separated from `halfCoord` and from its boundaryless counterpart `coord_eq_coordChangeL_coord`.

findings.fix: Move them into `Sobolev/Bordered/Basic.lean` next to `halfSectionChartData_coord_ae_eq` and `exists_section_memWkpLoc`.
findings.issue: The four wrappers `exists_ae_eq_halfCoord`, `eq_of_ae_eq_halfCoord`, `chartValueL_add_ae_halfCoord` and `chartValueL_smul_ae_halfCoord` are basic API of `BorderedSobolevSection` and do not depend on changing atlas. Their boundaryless counterparts live in `Sobolev/Basic.lean`, not `Sobolev/Atlas/Equiv.lean`.

summary: Ten declarations are misplaced: the five atlas null-set lemmas and the overlap lemma `halfCoord_eq_coordChangeL_halfCoord` belong in `FiniteBundleAtlas/HalfPlane.lean`, and the four `halfCoord` chart-data wrappers belong in `Sobolev/Bordered/Basic.lean`. In the boundaryless case the counterparts already live in `FiniteBundleAtlas/Measure.lean` and `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean` (null-set and overlap lemmas) and in `Sobolev/Basic.lean` (wrappers).
